biography.on_page: Sixteen-year-old boatbuilding apprentice at Tideglass; designs a working skiff commissioned by Sela and asks Maui to hold a plank and observe knotwork instead of taking over. Later story may involve other transport work, but this chapter establishes the apprentice's current craft.

personality.voice: Direct and proud of a carefully measured craft; resists showmanship and correction that ignores the boat's actual use.
personality.dramatic_pressure: Works, disagrees, remembers or refuses independently of Jasper and famous visitors

agency: A message requires a real trip; never assume an impossible instantaneous crossing
